service.method: SELECT CASE WHEN COMPANY_CODE = '01' THEN '1000' END AS COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , USER_NAME_LOC , USER_NAME_ENG , DEPT , POSITION , EMAIL , PHONE_NO , #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') AS DEL_FLAG FROM apps.IS_PE_INJANG_V WHERE DEL_FLAG = 'N' AND USER_ID IS NOT NULL

SELECT CMGL.COMPANY_CODE , CMGL.DEL_FLAG , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC AS SELLER_NAME_LOC , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_ENG , CMGL.LANGUAGE , CMGL.COUNTRY , CMGL.IRS_NO , CMGL.FOUNDATION_DATE , ADDR.CEO_NAME_LOC , ADDR.ADDRESS_LOC FROM SCMGL CMGL INNER JOIN SADDR ADDR ON CMGL.HOUSE_CODE = ADDR.HOUSE_CODE and CMGL.COMPANY_CODE = ADDR.CODE_NO WHERE CMGL.HOUSE_CODE= ${session.HOUSE_CODE}

SELECT BIZ_CODE , BIZ_CATEGORY , BIZ_TYPE , SELLER_NAME_LOC , IRS_NO , ZIP_CODE , ADDRESS_LOC , PHONE_NO , EMAIL , CEO_NAME_LOC , FOUNDATION_DATE FROM SBUPR WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BIZ_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE}
